brief.fact: Arusha Technical College was established in 1978 by the governments of Tanzania and Germany and is located in the Central Business District of Arusha City.

brief.source_title: Arusha Technical College

brief.excerpt: As a result of over 40 years of growth, ATC has established a new campus in Chemka Village, Hai District, Kilimanjaro Region. (Kikuletwa Campus), focused primarily on renewable energy training and power production. The College also operates a training site in Oljoro, Arusha District

brief.fact: The company services and maintains its safari vehicles in its own workshop.
brief.source_title: About us | Wilkinson Tours
brief.excerpt: All our vehicles are serviced and maintained in our own workshop to ensure that our guests travel in a safe and reliable vehicle.
